title: Wooden weapons
content:
# Wooden weapons

# Introduction

Wooden weapons is a series of weapons that deals only 1 damage. They are mainly suited for training and practice matches between players.
They can all be repaired at a level 1 Workbench, but they can not be upgraded except for the Wooden sword. All have 12 block armor.

## List of weapons

• Name: Wooden sword | Class: Swords | Stamina: 4 | Durability: 200 | Source: Crafted at Workbench for 5 Wood, 3 Finewood and 2 Corewood. | id: SwordWood

• Name: Wooden axe | Class: Axes | Stamina: 4 | Durability: 125 | Source: Found in chest buried in Viking Graveyard. | id: AxeWood

• Name: Wooden knife | Class: Knives | Stamina: 4 | Durability: 200 | Source: Found in chest buried in Viking Graveyard. | id: KnifeWood

• Name: Wooden mace | Class: Clubs | Stamina: 8 | Durability: 200 | Source: Found in chest in Combat Ruin and in Draugr Village Great Halls. | id: MaceWood

• Name: Wooden spear | Class: Spears | Stamina: 4 | Durability: 100 | Source: Found in chest in Abandoned Outpost and in Abandoned Hut. | id: SpearWood

• Name: Wooden sledge | Class: Sledge hammers | Stamina: 8 | Durability: 100 | Source: Found in chest in Swamp Runestone Tower and in Swamp Graves. | id: SledgeWood

• Name: Wooden battleaxe | Class: Battleaxe | Stamina: 8 | Durability: 200 | Source: Found in Mountain chest. | id: BattleaxeWood

• Name: Wooden atgeir | Class: Polearms | Stamina: 8 | Durability: 175 | Source: Found in Plains chest. | id: AtgeirWood

• Name: Wooden greatsword | Class: Two-handed Swords | Stamina: 8 | Durability: 200 | Source: Found in Infested Mine Treasure chest. | id: THSwordWood
